verdict.rationale: Bento ships an SDK and CLI, so an opt-out from the product's own telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack documents no such opt-out switch. The closest item is the OTel transport mode that 'skips the analytics layer' (bentolabs-docs-20), but that is about routing customer traces, an adjacent feature, not an opt-out of Bento's own usage tracking.
